outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution localization/density/cluster images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution localization/density/cluster images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes shows mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots for each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of proportion of clustered molecules per cell shows mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows single-particle tracking localization/trajectory images (micrographs), not a summary plot.
Panel G contains a histogram of diffusion coefficients and a line plot of mean square displacement over time; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory and kymograph images, not a plot of averaged summary statistics.
